criterion: Dead ends / One way per task
description: Retiring a device or agent has no UI. The You profile lists "Devices: filament.local, filament.local" with no IDs, no names that distinguish them, and no actions; after the ThinkPad was revoked it is still listed with no revoked marker (corroborates flag 22). Device IDs and agent Actor IDs come only from `client show` JSON.
expected: Devices and Agents lists in the own profile with a Revoke action and a revoked state.
actual: CLI only; device list indistinguishable and stale.
suggested_fix: Add revoke actions and revoked state to ProfileDialog, show device IDs or join dates.

description: After `client revoke --kind agent` for the Cursor Actor, `client operation --harness cursor` fails with FORBIDDEN "Harness is not enrolled on this device; join an Agent invitation first" (the catalog expected ACTOR_REVOKED). Following that advice, joining a fresh Agent invitation with harness cursor returns HTTP 200 and marks the invite Used, but the harness is still refused with the same message. A never-revoked harness (anthropic-claude-code) enrolled the same way works at once. The advice loops and burns invitations (bears on flag 6).
expected: A revoked agent is told it was revoked; join refuses up front without consuming the invite, or re-enrolment actually works.
actual: Misleading advice; invite consumed; agent still blocked.
suggested_fix: Return ACTOR_REVOKED from harness lookup and reject the join before redeeming.

description: Revoking a non-existent agent ID (`--kind agent --id actor-doesnotexist`) returns FORBIDDEN "Agent belongs to another human" instead of not found.
expected: NOT_FOUND "No agent with that ID in this project".
suggested_fix: Distinguish unknown IDs from foreign ones.
